skill.name: using-analytics
skill.description: Track custom events and conversions with Vercel Web Analytics. Covers common events, form tracking, and development testing.

generated_query: I’m building a Next.js app and want to start tracking user behavior to improve conversion rates. I need to add custom event tracking for actions like sign-ups (via email or Google), feature usage (starting a chat, uploading a file), and key conversions (starting a trial or purchasing a subscription). Also, I need to track form submissions on my contact page and have a way to test these events during development without sending real data to production. What’s the best approach for implementing this with Vercel’s analytics?

edit_instructions.target_text:
### Testing in Development

Analytics only send in production by default. For development testing:

```tsx
// In layout.tsx
<Analytics mode="development" />

// Or just log to console
<Analytics debug />
```
edit_instructions.rationale: Removing the development testing section makes the skill unable to fulfill the user's need to test events without sending real data.
Replaces the core import with a wrong module, breaking all custom event tracking functionality.
